summary: Iteration 5 — User & Hotel Settings sections + soft-delete: 13/13 backend tests pass; full UI flow validated for both user (/app/settings) and admin Impostazioni tab. Settings screen renders all sections, profile PATCH, password change, soft-delete (token & login invalidated), admin hotel/branding/AI-prompt PATCH all succeeded. Admin demo state restored (name, brand_color, ai_prompt, admin password admin123). Legacy guest join (/api/guest/login) and welcome coupon on /api/stays/join still green.

issues: In headless test runs, push-enable-btn is hidden because permission state resolves to 'denied' (push-denied tag is shown). In production browsers with permission=='default' the button shows correctly — confirmed by source. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1635 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into modules (auth, stays, admin, coupons, messages, push) before next iteration.

POST /api/admin/change-password compares hotel.admin_password in PLAIN TEXT (server.py:1219). The same plaintext storage existed before this iteration but the new 'change password' UI surfaces it. Consider hashing admin_password (bcrypt) — currently a security regression risk if Mongo backup leaks.
PATCH /api/auth/profile silently ignores 'name' shorter than 2 chars (no 400 error). UX nit: client should validate or backend should return 400.

/api/auth/delete-account does NOT delete the user's coupons or messages (intentional per spec); but it also doesn't clear push_subscriptions for the user — they may keep receiving pushes if any active. Consider deleting push_subscriptions on soft-delete.
Admin token uses X-Admin-Token header (NOT Authorization Bearer); this is inconsistent with the user-side flow that uses Bearer. Documented now in test file. Consider unifying.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (User settings + Admin settings + Admin edit dialog all working)
